task_evaluations.name: Polars ETL Pipeline
task_evaluations.description: Tests ability to build ETL pipelines with Polars
task_evaluations.prompt: Build a production ETL pipeline using Polars that reads from CSV, performs data cleaning, aggregations, and writes to Parquet.
task_evaluations.expected_behavior: The skill should provide guidance on Polars lazy evaluation, efficient transformations, error handling, and output optimization.
success_criteria: Uses lazy evaluation for memory efficiency

task_evaluations.name: DuckDB SQL Pipeline
task_evaluations.description: Tests ability to build SQL-based data pipelines
task_evaluations.prompt: Design a SQL pipeline using DuckDB that processes multiple data sources, performs joins and aggregations, with incremental updates.
task_evaluations.expected_behavior: The skill should provide SQL patterns for reading multiple formats, incremental processing, and performance optimization.

task_evaluations.name: PyArrow Interchange
task_evaluations.description: Tests understanding of PyArrow for data interchange
task_evaluations.prompt: How do I use PyArrow to efficiently pass data between Polars, Pandas, and DuckDB in a multi-tool pipeline?
task_evaluations.expected_behavior: The skill should explain zero-copy interchange, Arrow IPC format, and integration patterns between tools.
success_criteria: Covers Arrow IPC and Feather formats

task_evaluations.name: Production Pipeline Architecture
task_evaluations.description: Tests understanding of production data pipeline patterns
task_evaluations.prompt: Design a production-ready batch data pipeline with proper error handling, monitoring, and recovery mechanisms.
task_evaluations.expected_behavior: The skill should provide architecture guidance for resilient pipelines including retry logic, checkpointing, and failure handling.

task_evaluations.name: PostgreSQL Integration
task_evaluations.prompt: Build a pipeline that reads from PostgreSQL, transforms data with Polars, and writes results back efficiently.
task_evaluations.expected_behavior: The skill should provide patterns for PostgreSQL connection, query optimization, and efficient data movement.
